decks.notes: The deck focuses on assembling a game-winning combo involving Lotus Field and various untap effects to generate mana quickly. The goal is to ramp up mana production using cards like Sylvan Scrying and Voyaging Satyr, leading to explosive plays with cards like Dig Through Time and Emergent Ultimatum. The deck also includes tools for card advantage and control, such as Impulse and Bala Ged Recovery. Ultimately, the key strategy is to set up the right combination of cards to overwhelm opponents with powerful spells like Omniscience and Lair of the Hydra.

This Rakdos Sacrifice deck focuses on utilizing small creatures like Cauldron Familiar and Bloodtithe Harvester to continually sacrifice and create value. By combining cards like Claim the Firstborn and Witch's Oven, the deck aims to control the board and chip away at the opponent's life total. Mayhem Devil provides additional reach and damage while Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger disrupts the opponent's hand. The deck also features a companion in Jegantha, the Wellspring for additional consistency and flexibility. Overall, the deck seeks to overwhelm the opponent with sacrificing synergies and aggressive plays.

The deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Worldspine Wurm or Xenagos, God of Revels from the top of the deck. It also includes cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Make Disappear to manipulate the top of the deck to maximize the effectiveness of Indomitable Creativity. The deck also includes control elements like counter spells and removal to protect the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to be a creative and combo-centric powerhouse in the Pioneer format.

This deck focuses on utilizing Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Parhelion II to create a powerful combo that can overwhelm opponents. By using cards like Grisly Salvage, Vessel of Nascency, and Witherbloom Command to generate card advantage and find key pieces of the combo, this deck aims to control the board and set up its win condition. Additionally, support cards like Raffine's Informant and Skysovereign, Consul Flagship provide additional value and disruption to help secure victory.

This UW Control deck aims to control the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage provided by Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. The deck also utilizes Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion to gain extra value from blinking permanents. With a focus on disruption and tempo, this deck can stall the opponent's game plan while gradually building up board presence with shark tokens from Shark Typhoon. The mana base is optimized for consistency and the deck includes a variety of utility lands to handle different situations.

This deck focuses on utilizing auras to quickly boost creatures and deal damage to the opponent. The key strategy involves playing creatures with hexproof, such as Gladecover Scout, and then attaching auras like Ethereal Armor, All That Glitters, and Staggering Insight to them for additional power and protection. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful, evasive creatures that can deal a lot of damage quickly before they can respond effectively. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion allows for additional flexibility in the deck's build.

The deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with aggressive Boros creatures and burn spells. The main goal is to maintain pressure on the opponent with efficient creatures like Soul-Scar Mage and Monastery Swiftspear while using burn spells like Play with Fire to deal damage directly to the opponent or remove threats. The deck also utilizes cards like Showdown of the Skalds to refill the hand and maintain momentum. Jegantha, the Wellspring serves as a companion to provide additional value and flexibility to the deck.

The Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with low-cost creatures like Soul-Scar Mage, Monastery Swiftspear, and Pia Nalaar. It also utilizes burn spells like Play with Fire and Kumano Faces Kakkazan to control the board and deal direct damage to the opponent. Showdown of the Skalds helps refill the hand and maintain pressure, while cards like Runaway Steam-Kin and Jegantha, the Wellspring provide additional support and flexibility. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressively costed threats and burn spells, while also having ways to maintain its momentum throughout the game.

The main strategy of this deck is to quickly and aggressively sacrifice creatures to trigger effects from cards like Mayhem Devil and Witch's Oven. The deck also utilizes disruption spells like Fatal Push and Thoughseize to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The inclusion of both creatures and enchantments that benefit from sacrificing creatures allows for a versatile and powerful combo-based gameplay. Additionally, the deck includes a companion, Jegantha, the Wellspring, which provides additional value and consistency to the deck's overall game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using cards like Lotus Field and Arboreal Grazer, while also utilizing land and spell untapping abilities like Hidden Strings and Vizier of Tumbling Sands to generate even more mana. The deck also includes powerful combo pieces like Omniscience and Emergent Ultimatum to search for key cards and create explosive plays. By effectively managing resources and timing key spells, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its powerful synergies and potentially game-winning combos.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with cards like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic to play powerful threats like Bonecrusher Giant and Lovestruck Beast. The deck also includes versatile cards like Esika's Chariot and The Akroan War to maintain board presence and pressure opponents. Additionally, the inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides a consistent mana source and adds flexibility to the deck's strategy. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with efficient creatures and aggressive plays while utilizing lands like Lair of the Hydra and Mutavault for additional advantages.

The main focus of this deck is to create a strong devotion to green mana by utilizing cards such as Llanowar Elves, Elvish Mystic, and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx. This allows the player to ramp up quickly and cast powerful green spells, including creatures like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll. The deck also includes cards like Storm the Festival and Karn, the Great Creator to maintain board presence and control the game. Overall, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive green creatures and powerful spells.

This Rakdos Sacrifice deck focuses on using creatures like Cauldron Familiar and Mayhem Devil to control the board and deal damage to the opponent. It also utilizes cards like Bloodtithe Harvester and Deadly Dispute to generate value through sacrificing creatures. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion allows for additional mana ramp and flexibility in casting spells. The deck aims to pressure the opponent with aggressive plays while disrupting their game plan with removal and sacrifice effects.

This deck is focused on playing low-cost Spirit creatures with disruptive abilities to maintain tempo and pressure the opponent. By using cards like Mutavault and Supreme Phantom to pump up the team, along with disruptive spells like Spell Queller and Lofty Denial, the deck aims to keep the opponent on the back foot while chipping away at their life total. The mana base is also optimized for consistent and smooth mana production, allowing the deck to properly cast its spells and creatures on curve.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on utilizing low-cost creatures and abilities to quickly overwhelm opponents with aggressive early-game plays. The deck leverages cards like Reckless Bushwhacker and Venerated Loxodon to buff creatures and deal damage quickly, while also incorporating cards like Resolute Reinforcements and Gleeful Demolition for additional impact and control options. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional versatility and consistency to the deck's game plan. Overall, this deck aims to establish board presence and pressure opponents with fast-paced aggression.

The deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with Boros colors, utilizing quick and efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear, Soul-Scar Mage, and Bonecrusher Giant to deal damage early. Spells like Play with Fire and Lightning Strike are used for direct damage, while Chained to the Rocks provides removal. Showdown of the Skalds and Reckless Impulse help refill your hand and maintain momentum. With Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a steady stream of threats and burn spells, aiming to win the game before the opponent can stabilize.
